name: What is custom window trim and how does it enhance my home's appearance?

mainEntity.name: What is custom window trim and how does it enhance my home's appearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom window trim involves creating and installing unique decorative elements around your windows, tailored to your home's architectural style and your personal preferences. Unlike standard, off-the-shelf options, custom trim can significantly elevate your home's aesthetic appeal, adding character and a finished look to both the interior and exterior. It can define a room's style, make windows appear larger, or tie together different design elements. When considering custom trim, think about the existing millwork in your home; consistency in style often creates a more cohesive and sophisticated overall design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window trim creates unique decorative elements around windows, tailored to your home's style, enhancing its aesthetic appeal and character.
